blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision transformers (ViTs) serve as the backbone for countless vision tasks, including dense prediction tasks, such as segmentation and depth estimation, even though the quadratic complexity of self-attention severely limits feature resolution and induces spatial artifacts. In this work, we introduce ElasticDino, a lightweight adapter which produces high-resolution feature maps, adhering to the fine details of the input image. As a key insight, we observe the consistency of artifacts across channels, and simultaneously resolve them to match the input image structure. Using a slim architecture based on spatial deformations, ElasticDino produces pixel-aligned, high-resolution feature maps efficiently. Leveraging deformations allows strictly preserving sharp semantics, and thereby avoiding the smoothness biases inherent to alternative approaches. Due to the absence of ground truth, we employ pixel-level semantic segmentation and depth estimation with linear heads to predict a set of downstream dense tasks, guiding the deformation process without leaking task-specific semantics into the model. We demonstrate superior accuracy over current methods on a range of popular dense task benchmarks, with better computational performance.
blocks.zh: 视觉变压器(ViTs)是无数视觉任务的骨干,包括密密的预测任务,如分化和深度估计,尽管自觉的四极复杂严重限制了地物分辨率,诱导空间文物. 在这部作品中,我们引入了ElasticDino,一种轻量级适配器,它能产生高分辨率的特征图,坚持输入图像的细微细节. 作为关键洞察力,我们观察各种渠道的文物的一致性,同时解决它们,使其与输入图像结构相匹配. 利用基于空间变形的瘦小架构,ElasticDino高效地制作像素对齐的高分辨率特征图. 利用变形可以严格保留锐利的语义,从而避免替代方法固有的光滑偏差. 由于缺乏地面真实性,我们利用像素级语义分解和深度估计,用线性头来预测一系列下游密集的任务,引导变形过程而不向模型中泄露特定任务语义. 在一系列受欢迎的密集任务基准上,我们显示比目前方法更准确,而且计算性能更好。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : ElasticDino upscales ViT features and corrects their artifacts, allowing to efficiently train a variety of dense vision tasks.
blocks.zh: 图1:弹性Dino升级尺度 VIT的特征并纠正了他们的文物,使得能够高效地训练出各种密集的视觉任务.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Foundational Visual features have become the backbone for most vision tasks in recent literature. Under this paradigm, a large foundational model is typically contrastively trained to embed images into a latent space. This embedding is rich and semantic by nature, and serves as a great starting point for various downstream tasks with significantly less training requirements. Specifically, self-supervised features trained using a Vision Transformer (ViT) architecture (i.e., DINO [ 3 , 19 , 25 ] ) are employed in state-of-the-Art semantic, panoptic and instance segmentation [ 5 , 14 ] , object detection [ 16 ] , monocular depth estimation [ 22 , 34 , 35 , 2 ] , optical flow estimation [ 27 ] , and more.
blocks.zh: 基础视觉特征成为了近代文献中大多数视觉任务的支柱. 在这个范式下,一个大型的基础模型通常经过相形见绌的训练,可以将图像嵌入潜在的空间. 这种嵌入在本质上是丰富的和语义性的,是各种下游任务的伟大起点,培训要求也大大降低. 具体来说,使用ViT(ViT)架构(即DINO [3,19,25])培训的自导自导功能用于最先进的语义,泛光学和实例分解[5,14],物体探测[16],单体深度估计[22,34,35,2],光学流估计[27]等.

blocks.en:
Despite their stellar success, these models have an inherent flaw: built on self-attention, they require quadratic memory, imposing patchification of the input image, effectively restricting the resolution of the final feature maps and introducing artifacts in their semantics. Indeed, for most hardware, a patched resolution of 32 × 32 32\times 32 or 64 × 64 64\times 64 is typically used, even when training dense tasks such as segmentation or depth estimation. Typically, a densification head is added to recover full resolution, (e.g. DPT [ 23 ] ), which requires large amounts of data to recover fine details, as attested by the large and complex datasets used to train monocular depth estimation tasks [ 34 , 35 ] .
This approach implicitly also requires training a specific head for each downstream task due to poor transferability.
blocks.zh:
这些模型尽管在星相上取得了成功,但还是有内在的缺陷:它们建立在自觉的基础上,它们需要四相记忆,强制对输入图像进行补丁,有效限制了最终地物图的解析,并在它们的语义中引入了文物. 实际上,对于大多数硬件来说,通常使用32×3232\times 32或64×6464\times 64的补丁分辨率,即使训练分化或深度估计等密集任务. 通常会增加一个密度头来回收全部分辨率(如:DPT [23]),这需要大量数据来回收细细的细节,用于训练单相干深度估计任务的大型而复杂的数据集就证明了这一点[34,35].
这种办法还隐含地要求培训每个下游任务的具体负责人,因为转让能力差。

blocks.en: A different approach that has recently emerged in the literature [ 11 , 13 , 8 , 31 , 28 ] seeks to enhance the resolution of the produced features, indifferent the downstream task. As we demonstrate, such approaches still suffer from performance issues due to attention-based layers, and base their upscaling process on reconciling high and low resolution features through cropping-like mechanisms, leading to inevitable bleeding of feature semantics at boundaries.
blocks.zh: 最近,文献[11、13、8、31、28]中出现了一种不同的做法,力求提高所产生特征的分辨率,对下游任务漠不关心。 正如我们所显示的那样,由于关注层,这些方法仍然存在性能问题,而且其升级过程的基础是通过类似收割机制调和高分辨和低分辨特征,从而不可避免地造成特征语义在边界上出血。

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduce ElasticDino , a lightweight upscaling method to enhance DINO features, yielding efficient and sharp result through a deformation-based architecture and simple training through a collection of minimalistic heads.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们引入了ElasticDino,一种轻量级提升方法来增强DINO特征,通过以变形为主的架构产生高效而尖锐的结果,并通过收集最小化头来进行简单的训练.

blocks.en: To achieve this we first observe that artifacts are consistent across feature-channels, and can thus be resolved for all channels simultaneously (see Figure 2 , subsection 3.1 ). As such, matching of feature and image structure our primary goal, regardless of specific per-chanel values. Second, we observe that most feature artifacts stem from the added positional encoding or under-sampling of semantic edges, resulting in thickening of objects and region bleeding. Hence, we learn deformation fields that align all feature channels to the image structure, alternating between upsampling and deformation. We observe that deformations offer efficient structure preservation, inherently and consistently adhering to sharp semantics. This alleviates otherwise inherent smoothness biases that are typical to the mechanisms used by previous work, and hence minimizes bleeding and fuzzy transition artifacts. Critically, since no upscaled ground truth exists in our setting, instead of cropping or further under-sampling approaches, we train ElasticDino using a set of five lightweight downstream heads, each learning to predict a different dense map, while limited to a 1 ​ x ​ 1 1x1 receptive field, forcing pixel-level matching of feature semantics.
blocks.zh: 为了实现这一点,我们首先注意到,各种地物渠道的文物是一致的,因此可以同时解决所有渠道的问题(见图2, 第3.1分节)。 因此,将特征和图像结构相匹配,我们的首要目标无论具体的每个机械值如何。 第二,我们观察到,大多数地物出自语义边缘添加的位置编码或采样不足,导致物体和出血的区域被加厚. 因此,我们学习了变形字段,将所有特征通道与图像结构相接,在取向和变形之间交替. 我们注意到,变形提供了有效的结构保存,内在和一贯地坚持锐利的语义. 这缓解了以往工作所用机制所特有的固有平滑偏差,从而将出血和模糊的过渡文物减少到最低程度。 关键的是,由于在我们的设定中不存在被提升的地面真理,而不是收割或进一步采样不足的方法,我们用一套由5个轻量级下游头来训练ElasticDino,每个头都学习预测不同的密集地图,同时限制在1×1x1的可接受地上,迫使特征语义的像素级匹配.

blocks.en: Through careful evaluation, we demonstrate that ElasticDino produces high-quality alignment of semantics and structure, while removing artifacts such as those induced by positional encoding. Using lightweight heads, we report superior results compared to other upscaling methods on semantic segmentation, open-vocabulary segmentation, and depth estimation, with minimal computational effort.
blocks.zh: 通过仔细的评价,我们证明ElasticDino能产生高质量的语义和结构对接,同时去除由位置编码所诱发的文物等. 使用轻量级头部,我们报告优于其他提高语义分解,开放式-活性分解,和深度估计的分解方法,同时尽量减少计算努力.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Vision transformers and semantic features
blocks.zh: 2.1 视变器和语义特征

blocks.en: Vision transformers have shown exceptional performance on vision tasks, being able to model complex long-range dependencies, and setting state-of-the-art results in a variety of vision tasks such as classification [ 37 ] , segmentation [ 5 , 14 ] , object detection [ 16 ] , monocular depth estimation, [ 34 , 2 , 35 ] , joint text-image encoding [ 21 ] , Vision Large Language Models [ 30 ] , and image generation [ 20 ] .
blocks.zh: 视觉变换器在视觉任务上表现出了出众的性能,能够模拟复杂的长距离依赖性,并设定了最先进的等各种视觉任务,如分类[37],分化[5,14],物体检测[16],单向深度估计[34],2,35],联合文本图像编码[21],视觉大语言模型[30],图像生成[20]等.

blocks.en: Many of the above tasks relied on pre-trained ViT encoders, much like vision models previously relied on convolutional backbones such as ResNet [ 12 ] . Indeed, ViTs have shown the ability to generate spatial semantic features, which transfer to a variety of tasks. Chief among these is the DINO family [ 3 , 19 , 25 ] , which through unsupervised training provides exceptionally strong semantic features, and has since become the go-to backbone for various state-of-the-art models [ 34 , 16 ] .
blocks.zh: 以上许多任务都依赖于预先训练的ViT编码器,与之前的视觉模型一样,都依赖于ResNet等革命骨干. [12]. 确实 ViTs已经显示出生成空间语义特征的能力,这些功能转移给各种任务. 其中最主要的是DINO家族[3, 19, 25],通过无监督的训练,它提供了异常强烈的语义特征,从此成为了各种最先进的模型的骨干[34, 16].

blocks.en: 2.2 Correction of ViT artifacts
blocks.zh: 2.2 VIT文物的更正

blocks.en: In order to correct for artifacts in ViT (in particular DINO) activations, several methods have been introduced - though without considering higher feature resolutions.
blocks.zh: 为了纠正ViT(特别是DINO)活化中的文物,采用了几种方法,虽然没有考虑更高的特性分辨率。

blocks.en: Soon after the introduction of DINO, it was realized that a large part of the artifacts encountered were due to a leakage of global semantics in patch features [ 9 ] . ”Register” tokens were introduced and added to the tokenized image sequence, meant to capture global semantics, while letting patch features absorb relatively more local semantics.
blocks.zh: 在DINO推出后不久,人们意识到所遭遇的文物有很大一部分是由于补丁特征中全球语义的渗出[9]. “注册”符号被引入并添加到象征性的图像序列中,目的是捕捉全球语义,同时让补丁特性吸收相对更多的本地语义。

blocks.en: Self-Patch [ 36 ] improves upon DINO’s self-supervision approach by enforcing local invariances among neighboring patches, improving spatial consistency and downstream performance although without upsampling features to higher resolutions. This however requires retraining of the model.
blocks.zh: Self-Patch [36] 改进了DINO的自监督方法,在相邻的补丁中执行局部偏差,改善空间一致性和下游性能,虽然没有对更高分辨率的特征进行检测. 然而,这需要对模式进行再培训。

blocks.en:
More recently, Denoising Vision Transformers [ 33 ] was introduced to mainly resolve the artifacts introduced by positional encodings. They achieve this through decomposing feature maps into a ”ground truth” component and several shared positional noise components. They impose consistency between the features produced by image crops, thus removing positional information from the image features.
It is important to note that positional information in feature maps is nonetheless important; removing it entirely severely reduces the out-of-the-box ability to model positional dependencies between objects or points of the image.
blocks.zh:
最近,德诺瓦辛视觉变形器[33]被引入,主要解决由位置编码引入的文物. 它们通过将地物图分解成“地上真理”部分和若干共同位置噪音部分来实现这一点。 它们将图像收成所产生的特性相加为一,从而从图像特性中去除位置信息.
需要注意的是,特征图中的位置信息仍然很重要;删除它将完全严重地降低在图像对象或点之间建模位置依赖性的箱外能力.

blocks.en: 2.3 ViTs and dense vision tasks
blocks.zh: 2.3 ViTs和密集的视觉任务

blocks.en: The first ViT densification approaches were task specific, with Dense Prediction Transformer (DPT) [ 23 ] still being a popular architecture. It combines a ViT backbone with a convolutional decoder to generate high-resolution depth maps, leading to success in tasks such as monocular depth estimation [ 22 , 34 , 35 ] . In addition, ViT-Adapter [ 4 ] adds a trainable module to a ViT, injecting vision-specific priors. DySample [ 17 ] dynamic sampling, SAPA [ 18 ] and ReSFU [ 40 ] further refine spatial semantics. While displaying impressive performance, these approaches struggle with high-frequency details, and more importantly demand data-intensive per-task training. Thus inducing high costs and restricting applicability to specialized domains.
blocks.zh: 最初的ViT密度方法是任务特定的,而"感知预测变换器"(DPT)[23]仍然是受欢迎的架构. 它将一个ViT主干线与一个革命解码器结合起来来生成高分辨率深度地图,从而导致单相深度估计等任务的成功[22,34,35]. 此外,ViT-Adapter [4]在ViT上添加了可被训练的模块,注入视觉特异性的前身. DySample [17] 动态取样,SAPA [18] 和 ReSFU [40] 进一步完善了空间语义. 这些方法在展现出令人印象深刻的绩效的同时,却与高频细节相冲突,更重要的是要求每个任务进行数据密集型培训。 从而导致成本高并限制对专门领域的适用。

blocks.en: More recently, a series of task agnostic literature has emerged, surpassing results of the task specific approaches while offering better generalization. FeatUp [ 11 ] introduces two separate upscaling methods, both based on reconciling features for various augmentations of an image. The first is trained per-image and demonstrates honorable performance, but requires over a minute of training for every image, precluding most real-world applications. The second method results in a generic upscaler, which displays gross artifacts - unavoidable with the joint-bilataral-upsampling kernels employed.
blocks.zh: 最近,出现了一系列任务不可知文学,超越了任务特定方法的结果,同时提供了更好的概括。 FeatUp [11] 引入了两种独立的升级方法,两者都基于一个图像的各种增强的调和特性. 第一种是每个图像都经过培训,表现出光荣的表现,但每个图像需要一分钟以上的培训,排除大多数实际世界的应用。 第二种方法产生了通用的升级器,显示的是总的文物 -- -- 不可避免的是采用了联合加固内核。

blocks.en: Similarly, Lift [ 26 ] uses a simple CNN architecture which combines image and features and then upsamples them. The training procedure consists in matching upscaled features produced at a lower image resolution to features produced at higher image resolution, and not upscaled. As the chosen ”ground truth” is not free of artifacts, the incentive to fully resolve them is not complete. Further, the editing of feature values, which are mixed with image encodings, does not guarantee strict preservation of semantics.
blocks.zh: 类似地,"升起"[26]采用了简单的CNN架构,将图像和特征结合起来,然后加以取景. 培训程序包括将较低图像分辨率生成的升级特性与较高图像分辨率生成的特性相匹配,而不是升级。 由于所选择的“地上真理”并非没有文物,充分解决这些问题的动力并不完全。 此外,与图像编码相混合的特征值的编辑并不能保证严格保存语义.

blocks.en: LoftUp [ 13 ] passes images, features and positional encodings to cross-attention blocks. The training procedure is two-staged. First, they compute various segmentation masks on the image, use a form of bilateral upsampling guided by the masks, and use these as pseudo-labels. In a second stage, they perform teacher-student distillation, now using as objective the reconciliation of feature values along crops. This suffers the same issues, with direct feature value editing, and reduced incentive to correct artifacts, especially bleeding.
blocks.zh: LoftUp [13] 将图像,特征和位置编码传递到交叉注意力块. 培训程序分为两个阶段。 首先,它们计算出图像上的各种分解口罩,使用由口罩所引导的一种双边取样,并使用这些作为伪标签. 在第二阶段,他们进行师生蒸馏,现在将作物沿线特征值的调和作为目标。 这个问题同样存在,直接进行特征价值编辑,减少纠正文物、特别是出血的积极性。

blocks.en: JAFAR [ 8 ] uses cross-attention using the encoded image as the query, features as value, and both as key, to compute pixel-to-semantics attention scores and query them within the feature values. This ensures that feature semantics are preserved. The training procedure is identical to LIFT and as such lacks the incentive to fully resolve artifacts.
blocks.zh: JAFAR [8] 使用被编码的图像作为查询,特征作为值,同时作为键来计算像素到语义的注意分数,并在特征值内进行查询. 这保证了特征语义的保存. 培训程序与LIFT相同,因此缺乏充分解决文物问题的动力。

blocks.en: AnyUp [ 31 ] proposes a backbone-agnostic upsampling module capable of transferring across models without retraining the upscaling head. To address the computational inefficiencies and the tendency of global attention to reference distant, unrelated image areas, AnyUp restricts its cross-attention computation to local spatial windows, supplemented by a feature-agnostic layer to enable transferability. However, the training procedure relies on matching features from randomly sampled image crops. Similar to FeatUp, this formulation does not provide a strong enough incentive to fully resolve the inherent spatial artifacts of the backbone.
blocks.zh: AnyUp [31] 提出一个骨干不可知的提升样本模块,能够跨模型传输而无需再培训提升头. 为了解决计算效率低下以及全球注意参考远近、不相干图像区域的趋势,AnyUp将其相互注意的计算限制在局部空间窗口,并辅以特性不可知地层,使可转移性得以实现。 然而,培训程序依赖于随机抽样图像作物的匹配特征. 与"FeatUp"类似,这种配方并不能提供足够强大的动力来充分解决骨干所固有的空间文物.

blocks.en: UPLiFT [ 28 ] addresses the heavy memory bottlenecks of single-step cross-attention approaches by proposing an iterative upsampling framework. It relies on an encoder-decoder architecture equipped with a local attention pooling operator to maintain linear complexity with respect to the number of visual tokens. Similar to LIFT, the training procedure optimizes a multi-step reconstruction loss that matches iteratively upscaled features from low-resolution inputs to the standard features extracted from high-resolution inputs. By explicitly treating the raw backbone features as the ground truth target, this formulation inherits the backbone’s spatial artifacts and provides no incentive to fully resolve them.
blocks.zh: UPLIFT [28] 解决了单步交叉注意方法的沉重内存瓶颈,提出了迭代取样框架. 它依赖于一个装有局部注意力集合操作器的编码器-解码器架构,以保持视觉符数的线性复杂性. 与LIFT类似,培训程序优化了多步骤重建损失,使从低分辨率输入到从高分辨率输入所提取出的标准特性的迭代升级特征相匹配. 通过明确将原始骨干特征作为地面真理目标,这种配方继承了骨干空间的文物,没有为完全解决这些文物提供动力.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: ElasticDino is an upscaling network for DINO features, learned as iterative upsampling followed by elastic deformations of the features. Given an image and the corresponding feature maps generated by the ViT, our goal is to upscale the feature maps while matching the image structure. Figure 3 depicts an overview of the architecture: The input features are repeatedly upscaled and deformed, with the deformation field being predicted using convolutional layers. We note that the advantages of this approach are lightweight computation that allow for higher-resolution maps at negligible cost with respect to backbone evaluation, and better handling of high-frequency edges. Another major advantage of this approach is that since we sample from the original feature map, we diminish hallucination hazards, ensuring strong structural and semantic preservation.
blocks.zh: 弹性Dino是用于DINO特征的提升网络,作为迭代的提升样本学习,之后是特征的弹性变形. 鉴于一个图像和由ViT生成的相应地物图,我们的目标是在匹配地物图结构的同时提升地物图. 图3概述了该建筑: 输入特征被反复地提升和变形,变形场被用分层来预测. 我们注意到,这种方法的优点是轻度计算,可以以可忽略不计的成本在骨干评价方面绘制高分辨率地图,并更好地处理高频边缘。 这种方法的另一个主要优点是,由于我们从原始地物图中取样,我们减少幻觉危险,确保强大的结构和语义保存.

blocks.en: As there are no ground truth upscaled features available, we train 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolutional heads on a collection of dense downstream tasks, ensuring no spatial context and pixel-wise feature and structure matching.
blocks.zh: 由于没有地面真实度提升的特性,我们培训1×1 1\times 1 革命头,以收集密集的下游任务,确保没有空间背景和像素的特征和结构相匹配。

blocks.en: We emphasize that deformations strongly restrict the output, forbidding feature editing and preventing task leakage, or neglect of specific information correlating to the tasks used or not used during training. Indeed, when training without the depth and the segmentation tasks, performance remains strong on these held-out tasks. See supplementary materials for more detail. See Supplementary material for visualizations of deformations through upscaling process.
blocks.zh: 我们强调,变形会严重地限制输出,禁止特征编辑和防止任务泄露,或忽视与培训期间使用或不使用的任务有关的具体信息。 实际上,在没有深度和分门别类任务的训练时,这些被搁置的任务的表现仍然很出色。 详见补充材料. 见通过提升过程可视化变形的补充材料.

blocks.en: 3.1 Cross-Channel Consistency
blocks.zh: 3.1 跨渠道一致性

blocks.en:
Due to their patch-wise decomposition of the image and combined use of positional encodings, ViTs typically introduce artifacts into the produced feature maps. We identify two main types of artifacts (Figure 2 , bottom left).
First, in regions of near-constant color, positional artifacts are prominent and values may vary widely, without semantic difference. It has been observed [ 9 ] that this happens in great part from global semantics being locally encoded, but positional encodings are also a significant contributor, as they are the only varying input to the ViT in a constant patch.
Second is feature bleeding (Figure 2 , bottom right): objects and boundaries are dilated due to discretization.
blocks.zh:
由于它们通过补丁来分解图像并综合使用位置编码,ViTs通常会在所制作的地物图中引入文物. 我们确定了两种主要类型的文物(图2,左下方)。
首先,在有近常态色彩的地区,位置文物突出,价值可能相差很大,没有语义差异. 已经观察到[9],这在很大程度上来自全球语义被本地编码,但位置编码也是一个重要的贡献者,因为它们是常有补丁中唯一对ViT的不同输入.
二是特征出血(图2,右下方):物体和边界因盘片化而膨胀.

blocks.en: We make the crucial observation that ViTs introduce artifacts in a way which is consistent across channels (Figure 2 , top). To substantiate this, we look at edge correlation between channels, and the original input image: we analyze 1,000 random ImageNet images. In each image, we isolate near-constant regions with an unsupervised local-variance filter, followed by erosion at the patch-grid scale so that measured gradients are not contaminated by neighboring edges; images without a sufficiently large flat region are discarded, leaving about 10 % 10\% of images. This selection is purely geometric and independent of the correlations being measured. On the remaining patches, we compute Sobel gradients of the backbone feature map and input image, and report the mean cross-channel Spearman correlation of gradient magnitudes, alongside two baselines: the same cross-channel correlation over the full token grid, and the channel-to-image correlation within the same masked region. In flat regions, cross-channel agreement is substantially higher than channel-to-image structure for both DINOv2 (0.29 vs. 0.11) and DINOv3 (0.30 vs. 0.12), and exceeds the full-image cross-channel baseline (0.18 and 0.22), showing that channel-aligned artifacts are concentrated where image gradients are weak rather than being a generic property of the grid. As a control, at image edges the channel-to-image correlation rises and the gap closes (0.17 vs. 0.15 for DINOv2; 0.19 vs. 0.23 for DINOv3), as expected when feature gradients follow real boundaries. Gradient directions are likewise shared across channels in flat regions (mean cos 2 ≈ 0.73 \cos^{2}\approx 0.73 for both backbones). These findings indicate that one can learn a correction to all channels simultaneously, leading to very efficient resolution recovery.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一个关键的观点,即ViTs引进文物的方式是跨渠道一致的(图2,上)。 为了证实这一点,我们审视频道与原始输入图像之间的边缘关联:我们分析1000个随机图像网图像. 在每一个图像中,我们用一个不受监督的局部变异滤波器隔离出近常态区域,然后在补丁-网格尺度上进行侵蚀,这样所测量的梯度不会被相邻边缘所污染;没有足够大的平地区域的图像被丢弃,留下了大约10%的图像. 这种选择纯粹是几何的,独立于所测量的关联. 在其余的补丁上,我们计算出主干特征图和输入图像的索贝尔梯度,并报告梯度星等的平均跨通道斯皮尔曼相关性,并同时报告两个基线:在全符格上相同的跨通道相关性,以及同一被遮蔽区域内的通道-图像相关性. 在平地地区,DINov2 (0.29 vs.0.11)和DINov3 (0.30 vs.0.12)的跨通道协议都大大高于通道到图像结构,并且超过了全通道的跨通道基线(0.18和0.22),表明通道相通的文物集中在图像梯度较弱的地方,而不是作为网格的通类属性. 作为控件,在图像边缘时,通道到图像的相通性会上升并相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相 梯度方向同样在平地地区跨频道共享(两个主干区平均为2×××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××× 这些调查结果表明,人们可以同时学习对所有渠道的纠正,从而能够非常有效地恢复分辨率。

blocks.zh: 3.2 建筑

blocks.en:
The architecture, depicted in Fig. 3 consists of alternating Feature Deformation layers, which correct artifacts and 2x bilinear upsamples. A first deformation layer is applied, then followed by an alternation of upsampling and deformations.
The deformation process is guided by the input image, allowing to introduce the image structure at that resolution to guide the deformation of the features.
blocks.zh:
图3所描绘的建筑由交替的地貌变形层组成,这些地貌层修正了文物和2×双线上出图. 第一个变形层被应用,再由上采样和变形相交.
变形过程以输入图像为取向,允许在该分辨率上引入图像结构来引导特征的变形.

blocks.en: Each upscaling stage is composed of a series of Feature Deformation Blocks, which take as inputs the ”dirty” features at the current resolution and the image at the same resolution. These are projected to a common hidden dimension and concatenated; and then fed to a depthwise-separable [ 6 ] residual convolution network, which outputs a 2D deformation field. The field is applied to the input features to recover the denoised features.

blocks.en: The motivation for using depthwise separable convolutions is the desire to achieve an extremely lightweight architecture, given the fact that feature dimensions are already high, which at higher resolution leads to heavy memory and compute utilization. We observed no performance degradation as well as much faster training and inference.
blocks.zh: 鉴于地物维度已经很高,在更高的分辨度下会导致沉重的内存和计算利用,使用深度可分解分解分解分解的动机是希望实现一个极其轻重的架构. 我们没有看到业绩下降,也没有看到更快的培训和推断。

blocks.en: Unfortunately, we have no ground truth maps in the upscaled resolution, and thus need to define an alternate training objective.
blocks.zh: 不幸的是,我们在升级的决议中没有地面真相地图,因此需要确定另一个培训目标。

blocks.en: We make the observation that a well-upscaled and denoised feature map should be able, by design, to predict any dense task pixel-wise.
blocks.zh: 我们提出这样的观点:一个经过完善的升级和去诺的地物图,应该能够通过设计来预测任何密集的任务像素.

blocks.en: We hence introduce a multi-task learning approach, where we simultaneously train linear heads for downstream dense vision tasks (see Section 3.3 ). Crucially, the 1x1 receptive field prevents the heads from combining feature values from different spatial positions, forcing the predictions to only use the semantics at that exact pixel. Should a larger receptive field be employed, the incentive to match the semantics at the current pixel would be removed, and structure would be learnt both in the upscaler and the downstream head.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们采用了一种多任务学习方法,即我们同时培训线性头来完成下游密集的远景任务(见第3.3节)。 关键是,1x1可接受字段阻止了头从不同的空间位置来结合地物值,迫使预测只使用精确像素上的语义. 如果使用更大的可接受字段,将取消在当前像素上与语义相匹配的激励,并在上行和下行头学习结构。

blocks.en: It is important to note that this approach can only work because we are employing deformations and sampling from the features themselves. Indeed, if the upsampling process were to directly edit feature values, the semantics of the downstream tasks could easily just become ”baked in” to the feature maps, without any incentive to jointly edit all channels simultaneously. We show the effect of such an approach in an ablation study- Fig. 5 .
blocks.zh: 需要指出的是,这一办法之所以可行,是因为我们正在使用变形和从特征本身取样。 事实上,如果取样过程是直接编辑地物值,下游任务的语义就很容易被“嵌入”地物图,而没有任何动力同时联合编辑所有频道。 我们在一项消化研究中显示了这种方法的效果——图5。

blocks.en: For each downstream task (see below), we employ a simple linear head to predict the target. Furthermore, to encourage faster learning at every resolution, the same head is applied to every intermediate feature map, and the corresponding multi-resolution predictions are all used to compute the training objective.
blocks.zh: 对于每一项下游任务(见下文),我们使用简单的线性头来预测目标. 此外,为了鼓励在每个分辨率上更快地学习,每个中间特征图都应用同一个头,相应的多分辨率预测都用于计算训练目标.

The downstream tasks we use represent a diverse sets of maps to be predicted from the image. We find each to help improve overall embedding quality (see Section 4 ), and believe more can be added. We use the following downstream tasks: RGB reconstruction, monocular depth, semantic segmentation, surface normals, intrinsic decomposition.
Training is performed on two interspersed datasets: Hypersim [ 24 ] and Imagenet-22k [ 10 ] . See Supplementary material for details on losses and the training procedure.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: We perform quantitative and qualitative evaluation on a prototype designed to upscale DINOv2 features, and report the results below. We report semantic segmentation and depth estimation comparisons, and open vocabulary segmentation in the supplementary material. Following recent publications [ 31 ] , we also perform some of the same experiments for DINOv3 [ 25 ] features. For implementation details, including results from our training head tasks, see supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 我们对一个旨在提升DINOv2特性的原型进行定量和定性评价,并将结果报告如下。 我们报告语义分解和深度估计比较,以及补充材料中的开放词汇分解. 在最近发表[31]之后,我们还为DINov3[25] 特性进行了一些同样的实验。 执行细节,包括我们培训负责人任务的结果,见补充材料。

blocks.en: Qualitative Results are presented in Figure 4 . Along side the input image, we visualize the top-3 PCA components of DINOv2 features, and resulting upscaling maps. As can be seen, artifacts are corrected and crisp semantic edges are formed, corresponding to the original image structure. ElasticDino alleviates artifacts in low variance regions of the image, and demonstrates semantic results that are decoupled from RGB variations in the image. For example, The similarly colored faucet is represented with distinctly different features compared to the background, while the flag is represented similarly throughout even though it consists of differently colored texture. For a more comprehensive demonstration of qualitative results, please refer to the supplementary material. We also note that while positional encoding related artifacts are alleviated, the positional information itself persists, and is actually extracted from the features with more ease compared to competing upscaling methods. See supplementary material for details on this experiment.
blocks.zh: 定性 结果见图4。 与输入图像一起,我们可视化DINov2特性的顶端3个PCA组件,从而提升地图。 如所见,文物被校正并形成了简洁的语义边缘,与原始图像结构相对应. 弹性Dino减轻了图像中低差异区域的文物,并演示出与图像中RGB变化脱钩的语义效果. 譬如说. 与背景相比,相似的有色水龙头具有明显不同的特征,而旗帜在整个过程中也有相似的特征,尽管其由不同的有色纹组成。 关于更全面地展示质量成果,请参见补充材料。 我们还注意到,虽然定位编码相关文物得到缓解,但定位信息本身依然存在,实际上从特征中提取,与相竞争的升级方法相比更为容易. 关于这一试验的详细情况,见补充材料。

blocks.en: 4.1.1 Task Specific (Semantic segmentation)
blocks.zh: 4.1.1 具体任务(语义分类)

blocks.en: We train simple convolution heads for semantic segmentation on top of ElasticDino and compare performance with two leading dedicated segmentation methods, Mask2Former [ 5 ] and OneFormer [ 14 ] . The data sets examined are MS-COCO [ 15 ] , ADE20k [ 38 , 39 ] and Cityscapes [ 7 ] (Cscapes), all standard data sets in semantic segmentation benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 我们在ElasticDino顶部训练简单的语义分解的分解头,并将性能与两种主要的专用分解方法——"Mask2Former"[5]和"OneFormer"[14]相比较. 所审查的数据集有MS-COCO [15],ADE20k [38,39]和Cityscapes [7] (Cscapes),所有语义分解基准的标准数据集.

blocks.en: ElasticDino displays higher performance as measured by Mean-IoU (Intersection over Union) on all three validation datasets, with a very large margin on ADE20k and Cityscapes. Qualitatively (In Supplementary material) we observe not only better classification ability, but much finer segmentation boundaries. This implies obvious advantages to downstream applications where sensitivity is key, such as autonomous driving.
blocks.zh: 弹性Dino在所有三个验证数据集上都显示由Mean-IoU(Intersection over Union)所测量的较高性能,在ADE20k和Cityscapes上的差幅非常大. 定性(在补充材料中),我们不仅观察到更好的分类能力,而且看到更细的分界线。 这意味着对下游应用的明显好处,因为敏感度是关键,例如自主驾驶。

blocks.en: 4.1.2 Task Agnostic (Segmentation and Depth)
blocks.zh: 4.1.2 任务不可知论(分类和深度)

blocks.en:
As our primary comparison, we further compare to task-agnostic methods that employ DINO feature upsampling (Table 3 for DINOv2, and Table 4 for available methods with DINOv3). These include training free Nearest neighbor and bilinear upsampling, and recent state-of-the-art methods [ 11 , 13 , 8 , 31 , 28 ] . We follow established evaluation protocols, as described in by JAFAR [ 8 ] , measuring mean Intersection over Union (mIoU) and pixel-level accuracy (Acc) for the semantic segmentation task over four datasets, and Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) and δ 1 \delta_{1} (measuring the percentage of pixels where that are less than 25% of the ground-truth) for the depth estimation task over one dataset. In the supplementary material, we also compare performance for zero-shot open vocabulary segmentation, and the CLIP [ 21 ] backbone. As can be seen, ElasticDino demonstrates leading performance consistently for all datasets except Cityscapes. We interpret this surprising discrepancy to the lower ability for our method to capture small objects, possibly due to the low-frequency bias of the convolutional architecture. To support this class size bias, we provide in the supplementary material a comparison of model performance by object instance size, demonstrating that while ElasticDino vastly outperforms other methods on larger classes, it struggles with smaller ones, indicating both better semantic preservation but also imperfect reconstruction of small objects.
Notably, these improved results are produced with less computational efforts and memory footprint, as reported in Table 1 .

blocks.en: 4.2 Ablation studies
blocks.zh: 4.2 读取研究

blocks.en: We perform an ablation study on the architecture and design choices. In order to ensure a fair benchmark, we train ElasticDino and its ablations on the Hypersim dataset and omit the depth task, reserving it for evaluation. The training tasks are RGB, illumination, reflectance, residuals and normals [ 24 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们进行一项关于建筑和设计选择的研究。 为了确保一个公平的基准,我们在Hypersim数据集上培训ElasticDino及其活化剂,并省略了深度任务,将其保留用于评估。 训练任务为RGB,照明,反射,剩余和常态等[24].

blocks.en: First, we ablate the deformations, employing convolutions only. Second, we ablate tasks in a leave-one-out fashion. Finally, we ablate by progressively omitting tasks.
blocks.zh: 首先,我们减缓变形,只使用变形。 第二,我们以一个例外的方式放弃任务。 最后,我们通过逐步省略任务而减缓。

blocks.en: For each trained upscaler, we train a UNet head to predict the unseen depth, reserving a fraction as a test set (which is also held out from upscaler training), with SiLogLoss as the depth metric. Quantitative results are summarized in table 5 , and some qualitative results are shown in figure 5 .
blocks.zh: 对于每个受过训练的升级器,我们训练一个UNet头来预测看不见的深度,保留一个分数作为测试集(它也从升级器训练中进行),以SiLogLoss作为深度度量. 表5汇总了定量结果,图5显示了一些定性结果。

blocks.en: The ablation of deformations results in almost imperceptible differences in feature values: because of the lack of incentive for the network to jointly modify features, task semantics are leaked and baked into the feature values. Deformation-based upsampling preserves feature semantics, allowing only local feature resampling and alleviating catastrophic forgetting. When deformations are ablated, the upsampler can directly alter feature values and may encode only the supervised task signal, e.g. depth, rather than preserving semantic structure. However, because some tasks exhibit correlation with depth prediction (e.g. surface normals), and because residual connections let the features flow through, some ability to transfer is conserved. It can be seen that the model gets to good performance with low amount of tasks but still improves with additional tasks. When ablating each task individually, we see that every task leads to some amount of improvement in performance, showing that adding more tasks improves the performance.
blocks.zh: 变形导致特征值几乎无法察觉的差异:由于网络缺乏联合修改特征的动力,任务语义被泄露并被烤入特征值. 基于变形的上下标本保存了特征语义,只允许局部地物再作标本并减轻灾难性的遗忘. 当变形被消减后,上标者可以直接改变地物值并可能只编码被监管的任务信号,例如深度,而不是保留语义结构. 然而,由于一些任务表现出了与深度预测的相关性(如地表常态),并由于剩余连接让地物流出,一些转移能力被保存. 可以看出,该模型以低量任务获得良好的性能,但仍能以额外任务来改进. 在逐一制定每项任务时,我们看到每一项任务都导致业绩的一定程度的改善,表明增加更多的任务会改善业绩.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: 5.1 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5.1 限制

blocks.en: While demonstrating promising performance, ElasticDino struggles with distinguishing small holes in the source image that are smaller than patch size (see inset figure). Our intuition is that the convolutional layers still display low frequency biases especially at large receptive fields, even though leakage is mitigated due to the deformation. Further experimenting with alternative architectures with lower frequency bias may be rewarding.
blocks.zh: 在展示有希望的性能的同时,ElasticDino与源图像中小于补丁大小的区别出小孔相搏(见内置图). 我们的直觉是,革命地层仍然表现出低频偏差,特别是在大可接受地段,尽管由于变形而减少了渗出. 对频率偏差较低的替代建筑进行进一步试验可能是有益的。

blocks.en: 5.2 Future directions
blocks.zh: 5.2 国家 未来方向

blocks.en: Beyond solving the above-mentioned issue, a clear future direction is the extension of ElasticDino to other modalities, such as video or 3D. Video could be handled through video-specific feature generators such as VJEPA-2 [ 1 ] . 3D could be handled through multi-view projection of features from renderings, as done in TRELLIS [ 32 ] .
blocks.zh: 除了解决上述问题外,一个明确的未来方向是将ElasticDino扩展到其他模式,如视频或3D. 视频可以通过VJEPA-2 [1]等视频专用特性生成器处理. 3D可以通过从渲染的特性多视图投影处理,如TRELLIS [32].

blocks.en: 5.3 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5.3 结论

blocks.en: We have introduced ElasticDino , a solution for producing high resolution semantic features on top of vision transformers. We demonstrated ElasticDino achieves superior performance compared to existing methods, with lower memory usage and faster runtimes.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了ElasticDino,一种在视觉变压器上产生高分辨率语义特征的解决方案. 我们演示了"弹性Dino"与现有方法相比取得了优异的性能,内存使用率较低,运行时间更快.

blocks.en: ElasticDino, like the vision transformers it enhances, does not produce content that can be directly misused. As a foundational model, any broader impact, positive or negative, is likely to stem from improved performance in downstream tasks or the emergence of new applications.
blocks.zh: 弹性Dino和它所增强的视觉变压器一样,不会产生可被直接滥用的内容. 作为一个基础模型,任何更广泛的影响,无论是正面还是负面的影响,都可能来自下游任务业绩的改善或新的应用的出现.

blocks.en: Appendix A Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 附录A 实施情况

blocks.en: We train our model using batches drawn alternately from two datasets: Hypersim [ 13 ] , which provides ground truth for intrinsic decomposition and normal estimation, and ImageNet-22k [ 6 ] for increased image diversity.
blocks.zh: 我们使用从两个数据集中轮流抽取的批次来训练我们的模型:Hypersim [13],它为内在分解和正常估计提供了地表真理;为增加图像多样性提供了ImageNet-22k [6].

blocks.en: To avoid introducing additional datasets for semantic segmentation and depth prediction, we utilize pseudo-labels generated by pre-trained models, specifically, Mask2Former (COCO,ViT-Large) [ 2 ] and DepthAnything [ 17 ] respectively. These labels are computed for images across both of the training datasets.
blocks.zh: 为了避免引入更多用于语义分解和深度预测的数据集,我们使用预先训练过的模型产生的伪标签,具体来说分别为:Mask2Former(CO,ViT-Large)[2]和"深度一切"[17]. 这些标签是针对两个训练数据集的图像计算的。

blocks.en: To minimize parameter count and overhead on top of the base ViT prediction, we use depth-wise separable convolutions [ 3 ] . We observe no performance hit compared to regular convolutions, with significantly faster training and inference, and vastly reduced memory usage.
blocks.zh: 为了尽量减少参数数和在基础ViT预测之上的起伏,我们使用深度可分化的集合[3]. 与常规演化相比,我们没有观察到性能打击,培训和推断明显快得多,记忆使用量也大为减少。

blocks.en: We train in mixed-precision using an 8-bit version of the AdamW optimizer [ 11 ] , with parameters ϵ = 10 − 5 \epsilon=10^{-5} for stability, an effective batch size of 16 and an exponential learning rate decay starting at 10 − 3 10^{-3} . The final model was trained on a single A100 GPU for 24 hours, amounting to 3.42kg of CO2-equivalent emissions, fully offset by the cloud provider (Google Cloud Services), and computed using the MachineLearning Impact calculator presented in [ 9 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们使用 AdamW 的 8 位优化器 [11] 进行混合精度训练, 参数 = 10 = 5\ epsilon= 10 = 5 = 5 = 稳定, 有效批量大小为 16 个, 指数式学习速率从 10 - 3 10 = 3 起衰减 。 最后的模型在24小时内接受了单一A100GPU的培训,相当于3.42千克二氧化碳当量的排放,完全被云提供商(Google Cloud Services)所抵消,并使用[9]中介绍的机器学习影响计算器进行计算.

blocks.en: Appendix D Experiments to understand degraded performance over Cityscapes

blocks.en:
We investigated our change in relative performance on Cityscapes [ 4 ] , in contrast to all other datasets. We hypothesize it is because Cityscapes consists mainly of smaller objects and segments, connecting to our known limitation of filling ”holes” in feature maps. To further investigate this we evaluated AP (Average Precision) metric for the different models over segments of different size categories Small (area < 32 2 <32^{2} ), Medium ( 32 2 < 32^{2}< area < 96 2 <96^{2} ), Large (area > 96 2 >96^{2} ) as taken from COCO [ 10 ] instance segmentation evaluation methodology (see Figure 3 ). We also measured distribution of different segment size categories over the COCO [ 10 ] , Cityscapes [ 4 ] , Ade20k datasets.
From this can see that the lower performance of ElasticDino can over Cityscapes can be explained by its lower performance on small thin objects present in this dataset in particular.
